info.title: Nelio API
info.description:
Backend API of the Nelio learning platform. All paths are under `/api/v1`, except the unversioned probe `GET /health`.

Every error has the shape `{ statusCode, code, message, errors? }`; branch on `code`, not on `message`.
Check order: 429 -> 401 -> 403 ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED -> guards -> 400 -> 409.

Authentication: send `Authorization: Bearer <access token>`. Operations marked as public ignore it; operations with optional authentication accept no token but answer 401 to an invalid or expired one.

Any endpoint can answer 429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS (with a `Retry-After` header), 500 INTERNAL_ERROR and 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE. 503 means a dependency (the database) is temporarily unavailable, including a deadlock that survived the server-side retries; the request changed nothing and may be repeated later. No `Retry-After` is sent with 503, so use your own backoff.

Error codes: VALIDATION_FAILED, UNAUTHENTICATED, ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED, FORBIDDEN, TEACHER_NOT_APPROVED, NOT_FOUND, TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, INTERNAL_ERROR, RESOURCE_CONFLICT, INVALID_CURRENT_PASSWORD, TOKEN_INVALID, NO_LOGIN_METHOD_REMAINING, COURSE_ARCHIVED, COURSE_ADMIN_LOCKED, COURSE_ALREADY_LOCKED, COURSE_NOT_LOCKED, INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION, ORDER_MISMATCH, INVITATION_REQUIRED, INVITATION_PENDING, ALREADY_ENROLLED, APPLICATION_PENDING, ALREADY_TEACHER, LAST_PLATFORM_ADMIN, CANNOT_SUSPEND_SELF, CANNOT_BLOCK_SELF, CANNOT_BLOCK_ADMIN, LAST_GROUP_ADMIN, MEMBERS_UNAVAILABLE, CANNOT_MESSAGE_USER, CLIENT_ID_REUSED, REPORT_ALREADY_RESOLVED, FILE_TOO_LARGE, FILE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED, FILE_IN_USE, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

field.description: Property path of the invalid field.

code.description: Machine-readable error code; the frontend branches on this, never on `message`.

message.description: Human-readable text, safe to show but not to parse.

errors.description: Present for VALIDATION_FAILED: one entry per invalid field.

kind.description: What the file is for. AVATAR: any logged-in user. COURSE_COVER and LESSON_ATTACHMENT: an ACTIVE Teacher (otherwise 403 TEACHER_NOT_APPROVED).

file.description: The file. The type is detected from its content, never from its name or Content-Type.

originalName.description: The uploaded name, sanitized; for display only.

mimeType.description: The DETECTED type, not the one the client claimed.

url.description: Public URL of an AVATAR or COURSE_COVER. Null for a LESSON_ATTACHMENT (served through signed URLs only).

slug.description: The name with hyphens instead of spaces; unique.

completedLessons.description: Published lessons of the course that this student has completed.

percent.description: Live whole percent, rounded down (0 with no published lesson). It is independent of course completion: a completed student can show less than 100 after new lessons are published.

completedAt.description: When the lesson was first marked complete; unchanged by repeats.

courseCompleted.description: True only in the response to the request that completed the whole course (the permanent completion snapshot was written by this request). False on repeats and when the course is not finished.

actor.description: Who caused it; null for system events and when that account no longer exists.

data.description: Display snapshot taken when the event happened (for example `courseTitle`, `lessonTitle`, `reason`, `reinstated`). Keys depend on `type`.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` to get the next (older) page; null when there is no more.
